deviations.reason: The tokens-pd bundle declares `color-scheme: light dark` on `:host` as well as `:root`. Adopted into a real ShadowRoot that rule lands on the shadow HOST and overrides what it would inherit from <html>, and the host carries no [data-theme] — so everything inside the shadow root resolves light-dark() from the OS instead of the app's theme. The committed --dark baseline for this story was captured under `dark` (attribute dark, OS light) and therefore shows a LIGHT popover inside a dark dialog; every OS-dark profile renders it dark and differs. Fixing it means dropping `:host` from the color-scheme declaration in tools/style-dictionary and regenerating tokens-pd, which also affects ui-legacy — tracked separately rather than folded into the visual-regression change.
